attributes.title: describe_production_line
attributes.description: Returns a structured snapshot of the Alarm Flood production line: the five stations in process order (Kitting -> Mixing -> Forming -> Cooking -> Packaging), every tag on each with its units, engineering range, full tag path and configured alarms, plus how each station is running right now (throughput as % of nominal, buffer level, status, active alarm count) and the simulator's current phase. Call this FIRST when asked to build or extend a dashboard about the line: it gives you real tag paths so you never have to guess one, and the live state tells you which widgets are worth placing -- a line in a fault wants the cascade widgets (Sankey, Heatmap, Funnel), a healthy line wants the steady-state ones (Ring, Sparkline, Bar). This is a read-only operation.

parameters.name: line_path
parameters.description: Which line to describe, e.g. 'Site1/Area1/Line1'. Omit to use the simulator's default line, which is the one the Alarm Flood Event page drives and almost always the one you want.
